Northgate IT -- Incident Severity Policy (excerpt):
'P1 (Major Incident): declared when an outage affects 500 or more employees, OR any customer-facing revenue system, regardless of user count. P1s trigger an immediate all-hands bridge call and a status page update within 15 minutes.
P2 (Standard Incident): all other service-impacting outages. Handled by the on-call engineer within 4 business hours, no bridge call or status page update required unless it escalates.
P3 (Minor): cosmetic or single-user issues, handled via the normal ticket queue with standard SLA.
Note: office-specific facilities systems (badge access, building WiFi, printers) are scoped by headcount of the affected office location only, not company-wide headcount, since these systems are typically isolated per site.'

---
